description: State motor vehicle registration certificate: which vehicle, who it is registered to, the plate and its validity, and the fees paid.

issuing_state.description: State that issued the registration, as named in the document title, e.g. Florida.

registrant.description: The owner or registrant the vehicle is registered to, from the name and address block.

name.description: Registrant name(s) exactly as printed in the address block.

address.description: Full mailing address printed under the registrant name, lines joined with commas.

year.description: Model year, the part of YR/MK before the slash.

make.description: Make code, the part of YR/MK after the slash, e.g. CHEV.

body_type.description: Body style code printed beside BODY, e.g. 4D.

vin.description: Vehicle identification number printed beside VIN.

net_weight.description: Net weight printed beside NET WT, as a number.

registration.description: The plate and the registration period.

plate_number.description: License plate number printed beside PLATE.

plate_type.description: Plate type code printed beside Plate Type, e.g. RGR.

decal_number.description: Validation decal number printed beside DECAL, with leading zeros kept.

expiration_date.description: Date the registration expires, from the Expires line, as MM/DD/YYYY.

date_issued.description: Date this registration was issued, from Date Issued, as MM/DD/YYYY.

plate_issued_date.description: Date the plate was issued, from Plate Issued, as MM/DD/YYYY.

title_number.description: Certificate of title number printed beside TITLE.

class_code.description: Registration class code printed beside Class Code.

tax_months.description: Number of months of tax paid, printed beside Tax Months.

fees.description: Fees itemized on the registration. Leave a fee null when its line is printed with no amount.

initial_registration_fee.description: Amount printed beside Init. Reg., or null if blank.

mail_fee.description: Amount printed beside Mail Fee, or null if blank.

sales_tax.description: Amount printed beside Sales Tax, or null if blank.

voluntary_fees.description: Amount printed beside Voluntary Fees, or null if blank.

grand_total.description: Total amount paid, printed beside Grand Total.

is_test_document.description: True if the document is marked as a test or sample print, e.g. TEST DOCUMENT in the header.
